WITH actor_film_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    COUNT(film_id) AS film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
total_records AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM film_actor
),
proportions AS (
  SELECT 
    actor_id,
    film_count,
    film_count * 1.0 / total AS proportion
  FROM actor_film_counts, total_records
),
average_proportion AS (
  SELECT AVG(proportion) AS avg_prop FROM proportions
)
SELECT 
  p.actor_id,
  p.film_count,
  p.proportion,
  p.proportion - ap.avg_prop AS difference_from_avg
FROM proportions p, average_proportion ap
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
